integrity: The claim distinguishes the all-edge-generator classification and its enumerator from previously located general definitions and basis-membership frameworks. No independence or external validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to finite simple lollipop graphs \(L(k,\ell)\) with \(k\ge3\) and \(\ell\ge1\). The finite checker covers only \(3\le k\le6\) and \(1\le\ell\le5\) and is not used as the all-orders proof. Literature searches cannot exclude a poorly indexed equivalent result under another name.
title: All edge metric generators of lollipop graphs
